title: Becoming a wraith
summary: How the newly dead arrive in the Shadowlands.

claims.text: Whatever a person expected of death, the afterlife of Reapers, Shadows and Stygia matches none of it, which shocks most new wraiths.
One becomes a wraith by dying with unfinished business pressing enough to stay anchored to the living world.

title: Stygia and the other Dark Kingdoms
summary: How the newly dead learn the map of the Underworld.

claims.text: Stygia, capital of the Dark Kingdom of Iron, stands on stable islands in a calm stretch of the Tempest, walled against Maelstroms; wraiths who have lost their Fetters live there, as did Charon, and the smith Nhudri works there.
The water around Stygia is the Sea of Shadows; other Dark Kingdoms sit on their own islands in the Tempest, some in touch with Stygia, others hidden, and few risk the long voyage between them.

title: Renegade gangs
summary: The scattered groups outside the Hierarchy.

claims.text: Renegades have no single definition or united movement; they are many gangs of differing strength, place and purpose.
The struggle is lopsided, a giant swatting mosquitoes, but each gang the Hierarchy crushes or buys is replaced by another; some gangs only want to help their members or live on their own terms.
